parameters: Treacherous swine! Your army is annihilated! Surrender yourself, and Veridia's forces will leave Sayunaa in peace.
A thousand generations of curses upon you, Veridian scum. Mark my words, there will be a day when you bend the knee to us.
Final warning, Duke Rostam! Surrender, and return to your capital, or I will put you down myself!
You have indeed taken much from me...

note: Antares to fight with Rostam and lose eye but win
